contract: A reached dynamic string call or computed pipe to one of the four configuration intrinsics appends a source-site, lookup-byte, kind, line and owning-frame selection record with a monotone nonce before evaluating arguments. CONFIG and CHDIR tasks carry that nonce through saved frames and external pauses. Direct source-fixed calls, optimized fixed pipes and owned first-class intrinsic closures use their existing source or object identity. Historical selections remain in the private state after abrupt unwind; only the newest selection at the same source site and owner depth may be active. The log authenticates reached transitions within private state, not an arbitrary coherent replacement of the entire state.
